items.exampleEn: Please keep a duplicate of the key in a safe place.
items.exampleZh: 請把鑰匙的備份放在安全的地方。

items.exampleEn: The old cinema will be demolished next month.
items.exampleZh: 那間老電影院下個月要拆除。

items.exampleEn: Detach the form at the bottom and send it back to us.
items.exampleZh: 請撕下底部的表格，寄回給我們。

items.exampleEn: Our website needs a refresh; it looks old.
items.exampleZh: 我們的網站需要翻新一下，看起來很舊了。

items.exampleEn: Can you identify the man in this photo?
items.exampleZh: 你認得出這張照片裡的男人嗎？

items.exampleEn: What was your boss's reaction to the news?
items.exampleZh: 你老闆聽到這個消息時有什麼反應？

items.exampleEn: The cool wind was a welcome relief from the heat.
items.exampleZh: 涼爽的風讓人從炎熱中得到舒緩。

items.exampleEn: The gentle motion of the train helped me fall asleep.
items.exampleZh: 火車輕輕的晃動讓我睡著了。

items.sentenceEn: It took me a moment to identify my suitcase among so many black ones.
items.sentenceZh: 在那麼多黑色行李箱中，我花了一點時間才認出我的。

items.audioEn: They plan to demolish the empty factory by the river and build a park there.
items.audioZh: 他們打算拆除河邊那座空工廠，在原地蓋一座公園。
items.questionZh: 河邊那座空工廠會怎麼樣？
options: It will be pulled down for a park
It will become a school for children

items.sentenceEn: To my relief, the train was still waiting at the platform.
items.sentenceZh: 讓我鬆了一口氣的是，火車還停在月台上。

items.sentenceEn: Please stay in your seat until the bus is no longer in motion.
items.sentenceZh: 請留在座位上，直到公車完全停下來。

items.stemEn: Her ____ to the surprise party was pure joy.
items.stemZh: 她對驚喜派對的反應是滿滿的喜悅。

items.stemEn: You can ____ the hood from this jacket when the weather is warm.
items.stemZh: 天氣暖的時候，你可以把這件外套的帽子拆下來。

items.passageEn: When my parents bought an old house last year, they wanted to demolish it and build a new one. However, the builder suggested a complete refresh instead, which would be much less costly. First, workers detached the old doors and windows. Then they found something surprising under the floor: a box of letters more than fifty years old. My father managed to identify the writer, the first owner of the house. His reaction was pure excitement. He made a duplicate of each letter and sent the originals to the owner's family. It was a relief to know they were going to the right people. Now the house looks great, and our family has a story to tell.
items.passageZh: 我爸媽去年買下一棟老房子時，本來想拆掉重建。不過，包商建議改成全面翻新，花費會少很多。首先，工人拆下舊的門窗。接著，他們在地板下發現了令人意外的東西：一盒五十多年前的信。我爸爸設法認出了寫信的人，就是這棟房子的第一位屋主。他的反應是興奮極了。他把每封信都複製了一份，再把原件寄給那位屋主的家人。知道這些信回到了對的人手上，讓人鬆了一口氣。現在房子看起來很棒，我們家也多了一個故事可以說。

questions.questionZh: 工人在地板下發現了什麼？
options: 一疊五十多年前的照片
把信全部賣給博物館，換來一筆錢
複製每封信，原件寄給屋主家人
把信全部捐給鎮上的圖書館公開展覽

items.promptZh: 看到他平安到家，我們都鬆了一口氣。
referenceEn: It was a relief to see him get home safely.
To our relief, he got home safe.
rubricZh: relief 是名詞，常用 It was a relief to…、to our relief、feel relief 等
「平安到家」可寫 get home safely、arrive home safe 等，過去的事用過去式

items.instructionZh: 用 reaction 造一個句子，說說你聽到某個消息時的反應。
referenceEn: My first reaction to the job offer was surprise.
When I heard I got the job, my first reaction was to call my mom.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 reaction，常用 reaction to…（例如 my reaction to the news）
句子要說到你自己的反應
